title: Consumed CheatEngine.SDK identity
description: The reviewed identity of the exact CheatEngine.SDK package the Client consumes. Its field names are the consumedSdk names of the Client release tuple (cheatengine-client-tuple/v0). Four different hashes identify one package; each field names what it hashes.

version.description: The pinned version; equal to CheatEngineSdkVersion in eng/CheatEngineSdk.props. A stable release only.

range.description: The dependency range the Client packages declare, in NuGet's normalized form; equal to CheatEngineSdkVersionRange.

contentHashSha512.description: The NuGet SHA-512 base64 content hash read from the lock file: the hash NuGet computes over the package content without its signature, as recorded in packages.lock.json, in .nupkg.metadata and (with a sha512- prefix) in the package library entry of a plugin's .deps.json. It equals the SHA-512 of the unsigned package (the attested GitHub release asset), not of the repository-signed file nuget.org serves.

attestedAssetSha256.description: SHA-256 of the unsigned .nupkg attached to the SDK GitHub release and covered by its build provenance attestation.

nugetOrgSignedSha256.description: SHA-256 of the repository-signed .nupkg file that nuget.org serves.

nugetOrgSignedSha512.description: SHA-512 (base64) of the repository-signed .nupkg file that nuget.org serves, as NuGet writes it into <id>.<version>.nupkg.sha512 in the global packages folder.

sourceCommit.description: The SDK commit the release tag points to.

sourceTreeHash.description: The git tree of that commit.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the native Lua protection bridge inside the package.

sourceFingerprint.description: The bridge source fingerprint the SDK embeds: SHA-256 of the C source and of the xmake build script.

lockFile.description: The repository-relative lock file whose CheatEngine.SDK entry contentHashSha512 is read from.
